metadata.question: In the Norwegian Sea during Septermber 19, 2019, is the water color at (46.694935, -50.925784) more milky than (46.809436, -58.528990)?

1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Use Sentinel-2 SR (COPERNICUS/S2_SR) on 2019-09-19 for each point; if none, widen to ±3 days, then ±15 days; fallback to Sentinel-2 TOA, then Landsat 8 SR.
- Filter by point bounds; pick image closest to date and with lower cloudiness.
2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Mask clouds using SCL (cloud classes 3,8,9,10,11) and keep only water (SCL==6). For Landsat, use QA_PIXEL bits: keep water (bit 7) and remove cloud/shadow/snow bits (1,2,3,4,5).
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collections empty after recovery: C1.
- If valid pixel count after masking == 0: C2.
- If mean reflectance is null/NaN or outside [0,1]: C3.
- Otherwise compare mean visible reflectance (average of blue, green, red). If A > B: A (Yes), else B (No).

const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helpers
  function evalPromise(obj) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      obj.evaluate(v => resolve(v), err => reject(err));
    });
  }

  const targetDate = ee.Date('2019-09-19');
  const ptA = ee.Geometry.Point([-50.925784, 46.694935]);
  const ptB = ee.Geometry.Point([-58.528990, 46.809436]);
  const regionBuffer = 1500; // meters
  const scale = 1000;

  // Build date windows
  function windowRange(center, daysBefore, daysAfter) {
    return [center.advance(-daysBefore, 'day'), center.advance(daysAfter, 'day')];
  }

  async function pickBestImage(point) {
    // Try Sentinel-2 SR (tight -> wider)
    const tries = [
      {col: 'COPERNICUS/S2_SR', startEnd: windowRange(targetDate, 0, 1), tag: 'S2_SR'},
      {col: 'COPERNICUS/S2_SR', startEnd: windowRange(targetDate, 3, 4), tag: 'S2_SR'},
      {col: 'COPERNICUS/S2_SR', startEnd: windowRange(targetDate, 15, 16), tag: 'S2_SR'},
      {col: 'COPERNICUS/S2',    startEnd: windowRange(targetDate, 3, 4), tag: 'S2_TOA'},
      {col: 'COPERNICUS/S2',    startEnd: windowRange(targetDate, 15, 16), tag: 'S2_TOA'},
      {col: 'LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2', startEnd: windowRange(targetDate, 15, 16), tag: 'L8_SR'}
    ];
    for (let t of tries) {
      let col = ee.ImageCollection(t.col)
        .filterDate(t.startEnd[0], t.startEnd[1])
        .filterBounds(point);
      // Basic cloudiness property name
      const cloudProp = (t.tag.startsWith('S2') ? 'CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE' : 'CLOUD_COVER');
      // Add date diff
      col = col.map(function(img){
        const dd = img.date().difference(targetDate, 'day').abs();
        return img.set('dateDiff', dd);
      }).sort('dateDiff').sort(cloudProp);
      const size = await evalPromise(col.size());
      if (size > 0) {
        const img = col.first();
        const id = await evalPromise(img.id());
        const dateStr = await evalPromise(img.date().format('YYYY-MM-dd'));
        const cloudVal = await evalPromise(img.get(cloudProp));
        return {image: img, tag: t.tag, size: size, id: id, dateStr: dateStr, cloudProp: cloudProp, cloudVal: cloudVal};
      }
    }
    return {image: null, tag: null, size: 0};
  }

  function processS2(img, point) {
    const region = point.buffer(regionBuffer);
    const scl = img.select('SCL');
    const water = scl.eq(6);
    const clouds = scl.eq(3).or(scl.eq(8)).or(scl.eq(9)).or(scl.eq(10)).or(scl.eq(11));
    const mask = water.and(clouds.not());

    const vis = img.select(['B2','B3','B4']).multiply(0.0001).clamp(0,1);
    const visMean = vis.reduce(ee.Reducer.mean()).rename('visMean').updateMask(mask);

    const totalCount = img.select('B2').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('B2');
    const validCount = visMean.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('visMean');
    const meanVal = visMean.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('visMean');

    return ee.Dictionary({
      totalCount: totalCount,
      validCount: validCount,
      mean: meanVal
    });
  }

  function processS2_TOA(img, point) {
    const region = point.buffer(regionBuffer);
    // Use QA60 for cloud mask; use NDWI>0 to keep water (approximation)
    const qa60 = img.select('QA60');
    const cloudBits = qa60.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).neq(0).or(qa60.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).neq(0)); // opaque or cirrus
    const ndwi = img.normalizedDifference(['B3','B8']).rename('ndwi');
    const water = ndwi.gt(0);
    const mask = water.and(cloudBits.not());

    const vis = img.select(['B2','B3','B4']).multiply(0.0001).clamp(0,1);
    const visMean = vis.reduce(ee.Reducer.mean()).rename('visMean').updateMask(mask);

    const totalCount = img.select('B2').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('B2');
    const validCount = visMean.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('visMean');
    const meanVal = visMean.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('visMean');

    return ee.Dictionary({
      totalCount: totalCount,
      validCount: validCount,
      mean: meanVal
    });
  }

  function processL8(img, point) {
    const region = point.buffer(regionBuffer);
    // Scale reflectance: reflectance = DN * 2.75e-5 - 0.2
    const vis = img.select(['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4'])
      .multiply(2.75e-5).add(-0.2).clamp(0,1).rename(['B2','B3','B4']);
    const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
    // Bits: 1 dilated cloud, 2 cirrus, 3 cloud, 4 cloud shadow, 5 snow, 7 water
    const dilated = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).neq(0);
    const cirrus = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).neq(0);
    const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).neq(0);
    const shadow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).neq(0);
    const snow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).neq(0);
    const water = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 7).neq(0);
    const mask = water.and(dilated.not()).and(cirrus.not()).and(cloud.not()).and(shadow.not()).and(snow.not());

    const visMean = vis.reduce(ee.Reducer.mean()).rename('visMean').updateMask(mask);

    const totalCount = vis.select('B2').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('B2');
    const validCount = visMean.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('visMean');
    const meanVal = visMean.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('visMean');

    return ee.Dictionary({
      totalCount: totalCount,
      validCount: validCount,
      mean: meanVal
    });
  }

  async function computePointStats(point, label) {
    const picked = await pickBestImage(point);
    if (!picked.image) {
      return {status: 'C1', label};
    }
    let statsDict;
    if (picked.tag === 'S2_SR') {
      statsDict = processS2(picked.image, point);
    } else if (picked.tag === 'S2_TOA') {
      statsDict = processS2_TOA(picked.image, point);
    } else if (picked.tag === 'L8_SR') {
      statsDict = processL8(picked.image, point);
    } else {
      return {status: 'D', label};
    }
    const stats = await evalPromise(statsDict);
    const total = stats ? stats.totalCount : null;
    const valid = stats ? stats.validCount : null;
    const mean = stats ? stats.mean : null;

    // Validation
    if (total === null || valid === null) {
      return {status: 'C3', label};
    }
    if (valid === 0) {
      return {status: 'C2', label, meta: picked, total, valid, mean};
    }
    if (mean === null || isNaN(mean) || mean < 0 || mean > 1) {
      return {status: 'C3', label};
    }
    const validPct = total > 0 ? (100.0 * valid / total) : 0;
    return {
      status: 'OK',
      label,
      mean,
      total,
      valid,
      validPct,
      meta: picked
    };
  }

  try {
    const resA = await computePointStats(ptA, 'A');
    const resB = await computePointStats(ptB, 'B');

    // Handle failure states
    if (resA.status === 'C1' || resB.status === 'C1') {
      console.log(`A Images: ${resA.meta ? resA.meta.size : 0} | B Images: ${resB.meta ? resB.meta.size : 0}`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    if (resA.status === 'C2' || resB.status === 'C2') {
      // Print minimal context
      console.log(`A valid px: ${resA.valid || 0}/${resA.total || 0} | B valid px: ${resB.valid || 0}/${resB.total || 0}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    if (resA.status === 'C3' || resB.status === 'C3') {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    if (resA.status === 'D' || resB.status === 'D') {
      console.log('D');
      return;
    }

    // Print concise evidence
    console.log(`A: ${resA.meta.tag} ${resA.meta.dateStr} imgs:${resA.meta.size} cloudProp:${resA.meta.cloudProp}=${resA.meta.cloudVal}`);
    console.log(`A pixels: valid ${resA.valid}/${resA.total} (${resA.validPct.toFixed(1)}%) meanVIS=${resA.mean.toFixed(4)}`);
    console.log(`B: ${resB.meta.tag} ${resB.meta.dateStr} imgs:${resB.meta.size} cloudProp:${resB.meta.cloudProp}=${resB.meta.cloudVal}`);
    console.log(`B pixels: valid ${resB.valid}/${resB.total} (${resB.validPct.toFixed(1)}%) meanVIS=${resB.mean.toFixed(4)}`);
    const diff = resA.mean - resB.mean;
    console.log(`Diff A-B (meanVIS): ${diff.toFixed(4)}`);

    // Final answer: Is A more milky (brighter) than B?
    // Use a small tolerance to avoid noise
    const tol = 0.005;
    if (diff > tol) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
